map.由中子通量、截面与靶核数求反应率: Find the reaction rate from neutron flux, cross-section and target nuclei
map.输入中子通量 Φ、微观截面 σ、靶核数 N，求反应率。: Enter the neutron flux Φ, the microscopic cross-section σ and the number of target nuclei N to get the reaction rate.
map.📖 查看「由中子通量、截面与靶核数求反应率 使用指南」: 📖 View Guide: "Find the reaction rate from neutron flux, cross-section and target nuclei"
map.📚 深度解析：核反应速率（R = ΦσN）: 📚 Deep Dive: Nuclear reaction rate (R = ΦσN)
map.R = 通量 Φ × 截面 σ × 靶核数 N 得反应率。: R = flux Φ x cross-section σ x number of target nuclei N gives the reaction rate.
map.对比不同通量/截面的速率。: Compare rates for different fluxes and cross-sections.
map.R = 1e13 × 1e-28 × 1e20 = 1×10⁵ s⁻¹；通量翻: R = 1e13 x 1e-28 x 1e20 = 1×10⁵ s⁻¹; a tenfold flux gives a tenfold rate.
map.若 σ=1e-24（barn 级），则 R=1e9 s⁻¹，反应显著增强。: If σ = 1e-24, the barn scale, then R = 1e9 s⁻¹ and the reaction is greatly enhanced.
map.截面 σ 单位？: What is the unit of σ?
map.常用 barn（1 barn=1e-28 m²），表示核与入射粒子发生反应的\": Usually the barn, where 1 barn = 1e-28 m², which expresses the effective area for a reaction between the nucleus and an incoming particle.
map.单位时间单位面积的入射粒子数（粒子·m⁻²·s⁻¹），决定碰撞频度。: The number of incident particles per unit time per unit area, in particles·m⁻²·s⁻¹, which sets the collision frequency.
map.核反应率（本页代码口径）：R=Φ×σ×N（1/s，Φ 中子注量率、σ 微观截面、: Nuclear reaction rate (this page's code basis): R = Φ×σ×N (1/s, Φ neutron fluence rate, σ microscopic cross-section, N target nuclei); linked values: mean interval between reactions = 1÷(R||1) (s, with the denominator falling back to 1 when R is 0), macroscopic cross-section Σ = Φ×σ (page basis). Validation: no strict validation; empty values fall back to 0. Criteria: no fixed grading; the result is output in exponential notation, and R is proportional to the fluence rate, cross-section and target nucleus count.
